lyrics.text: Blue light's the only thing still awake in here
Everyone else went home hours ago, it's clear
I keep staring at the same broken little piece
Telling myself just one more try before I sleep
Started this thing back when the leaves were green
Now there's frost outside and I'm still stuck between
What I pictured and this half-built, stubborn machine
That only works when nobody else can see
Every time I fix one thing, something else gives out
But I've learned to love the problem, not the doubt
My friends ask when it's done, I just laugh and say
It's ready when it's ready, not a day
So I sit with the mess until it makes sense
Trade my weekends for a little more evidence
That the thing I see isn't just in my head
One more late night, one more thread
(Piece by piece - piece by piece - watch it grow)
(Break it down - break it down - then I know)
(Start again - start again - till it's clean)
(I built this - built this - from a dream)
I've rebuilt the same idea a dozen times
Thrown out the parts that only looked good on paper lines
Nobody claps when something quietly works right
But I felt that click at two in the morning light
My family thinks I'm just staring at a screen
They don't see the little world I'm trying to build between
The failures, and the one time that it holds
That's the part of me that nobody's told
So I sit with the mess until it makes sense
Trade my weekends for a little more evidence
That the thing I see isn't just in my head
One more late night, one more thread
(Piece by piece - piece by piece - watch it grow)
(Break it down - break it down - then I know)
(Start again - start again - till it's clean)
(I built this - built this - from a dream)
Maybe it takes a year to make one thing feel true
Maybe that's the cost of building something new
But when it finally runs the way I always dreamed
Every quiet hour will have meant exactly what it seemed
(Piece by piece - piece by piece - watch it grow)
(Break it down - break it down - then I know)
(Start again - start again - till it's clean)
(I built this - built this - from a dream)
(It finally works, and it was worth it)
(It finally works, and it was worth it)
